name: Colossus crab
notes: Origin on the ground under the carapace centre, face +Z, up +Y, 20 m leg span. Authored pose is the full stand with claws lowered and open and eyes forward. The crusher claw is on the character's right (-X) and is larger. Legs 0 to 3 are on +X front to back, 4 to 7 on -X. Joints walk -1...1 (alternate legs lift 14 deg and swing 10 deg), claws 0...1 (arms raise 65 deg), pinch 0...1 (dactyls close 42 deg), eyes -1...1 (stalks swivel 35 deg), crouch 0...1 (body lowers 3 m, knees flex 22 deg) are empty drivers; child parts mimic them.
parts: carapace loft 64 stations by 64 radial, cream belly, amber flanks, red-orange back, clearcoat
lateral, front and dorsal spines, barnacle clusters
crusher claw (large) and cutter claw with arm tube, palm, fixed finger, jointed dactyl
eight walking legs, four 48-sided tube segments with ball joints
kelp strands draped on the shell and crusher arm
style: Wet red-orange to cream colossal crab, spined carapace, barnacles and kelp, original design.
summary: 20 m colossus crab: wet red-orange to cream carapace with spines and barnacles, crusher and cutter claws, eight segmented legs with ball joints, stalked black eyes, kelp, joints walk, claws, pinch, eyes, crouch.
